As soon as I heard that Robert Hack would be our guest artist, I knew that there was no need to worry. One thing I did highlight earlier in the script was that these Ewoks would ideally look as near as possible to the murderous little critters in ''Return of the Jedi'', complete with their black eyes rather than more cartoon-like eyes as seen in the '80s cartoon or ''Caravan of Courage''. Although you'll find plenty of little references to ''Caravan'' in our story!|Cavan Scott|{{SW|url=news/the-spooky-secrets-of-idws-tales-from-vaders-castle|text=The Spooky Secrets of IDW's ''Tales from Vader's Castle''}}}} '''''Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle'' 4''' is the fourth issue of [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle]]''. The comic was written by [[Cavan Scott]], illustrated by [[Derek Charm]] and [[Robert Hack]], and released on [[October 24]], [[2018]] by [[IDW Publishing]]. ==Plot summary== {{Plot|comic}} ==Development== Writer [[Cavan Scott]]'s initial plan for the issue was to focus on [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket W. Warrick]] and [[Teebo]]. When the story's timeline placement was decided to be pre-''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', it was suggested by [[Lucasfilm]] to make [[Chirpa]] and [[Logray]] the protagonists before they became [[Chief]] and [[Shaman]]. The comic was illustrated by guest artist [[Robert Hack]], who is known for illustrating the classic [[Wikipedia:Archie Horror|Archie Horror]] comics. Inspired by Hack's inks, colorist [[Charlie Kirchoff]] developed a striking design with three color schemes, each using a limited palette. ==Continuity== ''Tales from Vader's Castle 4'' makes several references to the [[1984]] TV movie ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'' and [[1985]] [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'' cartoon]], including mentions of [[Chukha-Trok]], [[Ra-Lee]], [[Dulok]]s, [[Wistie]]s, [[Boar-wolf|boar-wolves]], and the titular [[Gorax]].''Tales from Vader's Castle 4: Night of the Gorax'' ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars Adventures:
